name: P-533 io2 filesystem comparison
command:
bash -s <<'IO2_FS'
set -euo pipefail
out=/var/tmp/io2-fs-eval
mkdir -p "$out"
dev=/dev/disk/by-id/nvme-Amazon_Elastic_Block_Store_vol0e714ef31e7ef6208
swap=/dev/disk/by-id/nvme-Amazon_Elastic_Block_Store_vol0e4f38d3592151d99
test "$(blockdev --getsize64 "$dev")" = 274877906944
! findmnt --source "$dev" >/dev/null
! blkid "$dev" >/dev/null
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q postgresql postgresql-contrib xfsprogs >/dev/null
pgbin=$(dirname "$(find /usr/lib/postgresql -path '*/bin/pg_ctl' | sort -V | tail -1)")
mkdir -p /mnt/db-eval
for fs in ext4 ext4-noatime xfs-noatime; do
 if [ "$fs" = xfs-noatime ]; then mkfs.xfs -f "$dev" >"$out/mkfs-$fs.log"; else mkfs.ext4 -F "$dev" >"$out/mkfs-$fs.log" 2>&1; fi
 if [ "$fs" = ext4 ]; then mount "$dev" /mnt/db-eval; else mount -o noatime "$dev" /mnt/db-eval; fi
 install -d -o postgres -g postgres -m 700 /mnt/db-eval/pgdata
 root=/mnt/db-eval/pgdata
 runuser -u postgres -- "$pgbin/initdb" -D "$root" >"$out/init-$fs.log"
 printf "\nshared_buffers=1GB\nmax_connections=32\nlisten_addresses=''\nfsync=on\nsynchronous_commit=on\nfull_page_writes=on\n" >>"$root/postgresql.conf"
 runuser -u postgres -- "$pgbin/pg_ctl" -D "$root" -l "$root/server.log" -o '-p 55432 -k /var/run/postgresql' start >/dev/null
 runuser -u postgres -- createdb -h /var/run/postgresql -p 55432 bench
 runuser -u postgres -- pgbench -h /var/run/postgresql -p 55432 -i -s 100 bench >"$out/load-$fs.log" 2>&1
 for pass in 1 2; do
  fio --name=swap-pressure --filename="$swap" --rw=randrw --rwmixread=90 --bs=4k --direct=1 --ioengine=libaio --iodepth=32 --size=4G --time_based --runtime=35 --output-format=json >"$out/fio-$fs-$pass.json" &
  fp=$!
  runuser -u postgres -- pgbench -h /var/run/postgresql -p 55432 -c 8 -j 4 -T 30 -P 10 bench >"$out/pg-$fs-$pass.log" 2>&1
  wait "$fp"
 done
 runuser -u postgres -- "$pgbin/pg_ctl" -D "$root" stop >/dev/null
 findmnt /mnt/db-eval >"$out/mount-$fs.txt"
 umount /mnt/db-eval
 echo "FILESYSTEM_DONE $fs"
done
sysctl vm.swappiness vm.page-cluster >"$out/kernel.txt"
cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled >>"$out/kernel.txt"
echo FS_EVAL_COMPLETE

IO2_FS
summary: Three filesystem configurations, two durable pgbench passes each under competing swap-device I/O; zero failed transactions.

assertions.evidence: Exact command above enables all three durability settings.
